source.name: Qatar Tribune - Visit Qatar announces return of UFC Fight Night to Doha
source.note: Visit Qatar announced UFC Fight Night 294 for Ali Bin Hamad Al Attiyah Arena on 21 Nov 2026, 'following the success of the inaugural event in Qatar last year' (Tsarukyan vs. Hooker, Doha, Nov 2025).

note: Visit Qatar (Qatar Tourism) is the event host/destination partner for UFC's Qatar events; host fee not published.
